plan.title: Prepare and execute native Linux amd64 full verification in GitHub CI

criteria.description: A least-privilege Ubuntu amd64 workflow installs pinned Go and existing pinned analysis tools and runs format, vet, race tests, cross-vet, build and naru check. Confirm actual remote run success and architecture before closure.

limitations: User authorized GitHub runner preparation and actual validation. Push a dedicated CI branch; no main push, repository settings, releases or local system installation. Minimum Go full suite is separate P04.
